data.body_html:
The May bank holiday is one of the best times to experience the Costa del Sol. With warm weather, calm seas, and longer daylight hours, a Marbella yacht charter May bank holiday offers the perfect escape. Our fleet of 16 boats departs directly from Puerto Banús, so you can step aboard and start cruising within minutes. Whether you want a fast 2-hour spin or a full-day voyage to Estepona or Sotogrande, we have a boat and a price that fits.

Why choose a May bank holiday yacht charter in Marbella?

May delivers ideal conditions: air temperatures of 22–26°C, sea temperatures of 18–20°C, and minimal wind. The water is warm enough for swimming, and the sun is strong but not scorching. The May bank holiday weekend sees fewer crowds than July or August, meaning you can enjoy the coastline with more space and less traffic. Departing from Puerto Banús gives you immediate access to the Marbella coast, with landmarks like La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile visible from the water.

Our fleet for May bank holiday charters

We offer boats for every group size and budget. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Here is a quick overview of our most popular options for the May bank holiday.

For smaller groups, the Marbella yacht charter options like the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) are ideal for a quick outing. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on these and all other boats.

Best routes for a May bank holiday charter

From Puerto Banús, you have several excellent routes. A short 2-hour cruise takes you east past the Marbella marina and the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha. For swimming, head to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés—quiet coves with clear water. A 4-hour trip can reach Cabopino or Estepona, where you can dock for lunch. Full-day (8-hour) charters allow you to go as far as Sotogrande, a luxury marina with restaurants and golf courses. The Mangusta 80, with its free jet ski, adds extra fun for water sports.

What to expect on board

Every charter includes a professional skipper who knows the local waters and can suggest the best spots. You will have unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. The boat is equipped with safety gear, insurance, and fuel for the entire trip. You can bring your own food and drinks if you prefer. Most boats have a sun deck, shaded saloon, and a bathroom. The larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 and Azimut 58 Flybridge offer air-conditioned interiors and full galleys.

Tips for booking your May bank holiday charter

  • Book by mid-April to secure your preferred boat and time slot.
  • Consider a morning departure (10:00 or 11:00) for calmer seas and better light.
  • If you want the Mangusta 80, remember the minimum is 4 hours at €4,719.
  • For larger groups (up to 12), the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 are top choices.
  • Check the weather forecast a day before; May is stable but occasional breezes can occur.
  • Bring sunscreen, a towel, and a light jacket for the evening return.

Why book with us?

We operate our own fleet from Puerto Banús, so there are no middlemen. Our prices are transparent: Tier A boats at €749/2h or €2,299/8h, Mangusta 80 at €4,719/4h, and all other boats priced on request. Every charter includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. We have been running charters for years and know the best spots for May. For a Marbella yacht charter May bank holiday, we are your direct line to the water.

Frequently asked questions

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) offers space, speed, and a free jet ski. For smaller parties (9-11 pax), the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are cost-effective at €749/2h. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Yes, you can bring extra food and drinks. The provided drinks and snacks are included, but you are welcome to add your own. Catering upgrades are available on request.

What is the weather like in Marbella during the May bank holiday?

May in Marbella averages 22-26°C air temperature and 18-20°C sea temperature. Expect mostly sunny days with light breezes. Ideal for cruising, swimming, and sunbathing.

How far in advance should I book for the May bank holiday?

We recommend booking by mid-April. The May bank holiday is popular, and our fleet—especially the larger yachts—fills quickly. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

What are the best destinations for a May bank holiday charter?

Popular routes include cruising along the Marbella coast to Cabopino, stopping at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming, or heading to Estepona for lunch. Longer charters can reach Sotogrande.

Do I need a boating license to charter a yacht in Marbella?

No. All our charters include a licensed skipper who handles navigation and docking. You just relax and enjoy.
